lead: Vijay Rupani was an Indian politician, born on 2 August 1956 in Yangon.
He died on 12 June 2025 in Ahmedabad at the age of 68.
He has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha and Member of the Gujarat Legislative Assembly.
Below you will find a verified overview of Vijay Rupani: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Vijay Rupani — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Vijay Rupani was born on 2 August 1956 in Yangon, and holds Indian nationality.
He is recorded as speaking Gujarati.

sections.heading: Vijay Rupani — Career and Professional Work
paras: Vijay Rupani works primarily as a politician.

He has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha (2006–2012), Member of the Gujarat Legislative Assembly (2014–2022) and Chief Minister of Gujarat (2016–2021). He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
